posts.title: PlanetScale Neki: designing a planned Postgres switchover for minimal disruption
posts.summary: PlanetScale describes how Neki shards promote a replica to primary for pod replacement, kernel upgrades, or cell moves. The post covers the design to minimize write unavailability during a planned switchover, as opposed to unplanned failover.

posts.title: Percona Operator for MySQL 1.3.0: zero-data-loss async failover and encrypted PITR
posts.summary: The release adds async cluster failover that avoids losing in-flight data. Point-in-time recovery now works when binary logs are encrypted at rest, and the operator auto-tunes MySQL from pod resources.

posts.title: IBM FlashCore Module now detects data exfiltration inside the drive
posts.summary: IBM FlashSystem 5600/7600/9600 arrays with fifth-generation FlashCore Modules learn each volume's normal read pattern. They flag anomalous reads and confirm a suspected event over a 30-minute window. IBM claims under 1% false positives, alongside the existing in-drive ransomware encryption detection.

posts.title: Benchmarking vector search across six database engines with 990K embeddings
posts.summary: Percona loaded 990,000 1,536-dimension OpenAI embeddings into six databases and built HNSW indexes in each. It measured time to a queryable index, storage and memory, recall vs throughput, concurrency, and behavior when 10% of the corpus is rewritten.
